## About
Speedtek Performance started with a simple goal: old fashioned, hands-on service paired with the latest in high performance engineering. That is still how we work every day. Whether you raced back in the day or you are just breaking into the scene, you get the same personal, professional service.
We spend our own time at local drag strips, circle tracks and speedways, and our technicians keep training on the latest trends and equipment. What we learn gets passed on to you, so when you buy a part from us you know it is worth the money.
Customers rate us 4.2 on Google from 127 reviews, and many come back for the next project.

## Services
- Tuning: Tuning done right on the car you care about.
- Custom engine builds: Engines built to the performance you want.
- LS retro fit engine swaps: LS swaps for the car or truck you want to bring up to speed.
- Custom built turbo systems: Turbo systems built for your car.
- Custom supercharger setups: Supercharger setups built for your car.
- Custom stainless exhaust systems: Stainless exhaust built to fit your car or truck.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on imports and trucks?
A: Yes. We work on everything from cars to trucks, domestic or import, street and race.

Q: Will you tune a carbureted car?
A: Yes. One reviewer brought in a carbureted classic that other shops would not touch, and we got it running smooth.

Q: What if a part fails after the job?
A: We offer a complete warranty on all parts and service. If something goes wrong, we will take care of the problem.
